newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MTK BEAT BVSC 6-0 IN HUNGARIAN CUP FINAL 1ST LEG.
newsitem.headline: MTK BEAT BVSC 6-0 IN HUNGARIAN CUP FINAL 1ST LEG.

text.p: Hungarian champions MTK of Budapest took an important step towards the league and cup double on Wednesday when they beat another Budapest club BVSC 6-0 in the first leg of the Hungarian Cup final.
Gabor Halmai set the victory up in the 13th minute with a close-range shot after a corner-kick.
In the 29th minute Bela Illes cut in from the left, beat one player and scored from five metres.
MTK ended a one-sided first half 4-0 up, following two more goals from Illes and Ferenc Orosz.
After the break, MTK attacks lost some steam, but the ordeal of the tired and disappointed BVSC continued.
In the 69th minute Kenesei headed in a corner-kick.
Emil Lorincz sealed the 6-0 result with a penalty kick in the 86th minute, further reducing BVSC's hopes for the second leg, for which the two teams meet at BVSC on June 11.
